purposes: Separate a broker response from the final state of its order, fills and positions.
State the proof required BEFORE an automatic close-out retry can ever be considered under Q120.
Keep Q195-Q199 no-blind-resend rule and Q121 independent stop latches.
Generate offline hypothetical cases without issuing, simulating as real, or authorizing any broker order.

response_classes.meaning: Transport/API accepted or acknowledged; not proof of complete fill, closure or correct residual position.
API explicitly rejected. Without trustworthy broker-order/position/history reconciliation this does not prove nonexecution.
Timeout, loss of response, process crash, ambiguous broker code, uncertain send or log/DB discrepancy.

durable_evidence_order: Before side effects: Q195 logical-operation ID and per-attempt ID registered with Q196 uniqueness control; Q197 PREPARED intent committed successfully.
Immediately before external dispatch: Q198 DISPATCHING recorded and transaction commit confirmed; this records POSSIBILITY of sending, not that a send occurred.
On return or absence of response: Q199 response class recorded with attempt correlation if reliably known; accepted/rejected do not settle filled and position state.

Reconcile independent broker orders, executions/fills, open positions, pending/close orders, server-side SL and sufficiently complete history with local persistence for same account and logical close intent.
Recalculate outstanding quantity/side per position; detect late fills, partial fills, manual intervention, concurrent algorithms, inconsistent timestamps, duplicate or reversal risk.

Only if every required broker/local proof is complete, internally consistent, sufficiently fresh and retry eligibility is unambiguous may a separate approved policy CONSIDER a new close-out attempt; new UUID alone never suffices.

minimum_proofs_for_retry_consideration.name: CORRELATED_IDS
minimum_proofs_for_retry_consideration.description: Original logical intent ID and previous attempt ID as well as account, instrument, position ticket or unambiguous broker identity can be tracked without collision/ambiguity.

minimum_proofs_for_retry_consideration.name: BROKER_EXECUTION_HISTORY
minimum_proofs_for_retry_consideration.description: Independent, authoritative broker-side order, deal/fill and pending order states cover the relevant attempt and its possible late effects.

minimum_proofs_for_retry_consideration.name: CURRENT_POSITION_RECONCILIATION
minimum_proofs_for_retry_consideration.description: Fresh current position(s), quantities and sides agree with fills and are reconciled against the pre-attempt baseline.

minimum_proofs_for_retry_consideration.name: NO_PENDING_DUPLICATE_OR_LATE_EXECUTION
minimum_proofs_for_retry_consideration.description: No unresolved outstanding close request, delayed response, pending fill or duplicated logical execution could overlap the next attempt.

minimum_proofs_for_retry_consideration.name: RESIDUAL_AND_SIDE_KNOWN
minimum_proofs_for_retry_consideration.description: Any residual close quantity and trade side are positively identified, never inferred solely from a response code or local request amount; reversal/overclose risk ruled out.

minimum_proofs_for_retry_consideration.name: SERVER_SL_AND_SAFETY_STATE
minimum_proofs_for_retry_consideration.description: Server-side SL status, other active stop reasons, position management and recovery state have been reconciled and preserved.

minimum_proofs_for_retry_consideration.name: DB_AND_CLOCK_INTEGRITY
minimum_proofs_for_retry_consideration.description: Durable intent/attempt log and broker snapshot are complete, causal/time consistency and data freshness verified; crash/clock/restart anomalies cannot be misread as no execution.

minimum_proofs_for_retry_consideration.name: POLICY_AND_OPERATIONAL_GATE
minimum_proofs_for_retry_consideration.description: Retry count, minimum interval, broker rejection category, market hours, allowed atomic transition, error-specific exceptions and operator escalation policy have been explicitly defined and later approved.

draft_review_outcomes.meaning: Unknown or incomplete external effects, position/order state, identity, or durable persistence; maintain new-order and retry stop, alert and escalate under Q120.
Independently verified all requested positions closed and no residual quantity; do not send a duplicate close attempt. Stop reasons remain separately latched.
Verified residual quantity and no pending/late/duplicate/reversal risk; must still pass EP-08 and later approved broker-specific logic before any close attempt.
A dependent infrastructure/approval safety gate blocks action; unknown state or a prohibited automatic restart cannot be overridden by retry eligibility.

synthetic_cases.situation: DISPATCHING is durable but process crashed before send and no broker history continuity proved
API returned RESPONSE_ACCEPTED but fill confirmation and residual positions unavailable
API returned RESPONSE_REJECTED but broker history/positions not independently verified
Broker confirms complete liquidation, no residual position or pending close request
Broker confirms failed close with residual exposure, complete order/fill/SL proof and no overlapping execution
Partial fill and remaining exact position reconciled with all pending-close and duplicate risks excluded
Partial fill known but remaining quantities or order history disagree
Broker response lost and original close may execute late after a new UUID
Fresh current position is zero but an unconfirmed pending close could create a reversal
Network isolation failure latch is unresolved even when position snapshot appears consistent
Manual trade or second worker changed the position after the snapshot; stale data
Confirmed complete close after DD5%, but DD5 human-approval stop remains active

non_implications: No example represents a broker integration, automatic retransmission authorization or guaranteed idempotence/Exactly Once.
ELIGIBLE_FOR_LATER_POLICY_CHECK is an offline review category, not an order, automatic retry, trading gate unlock or approval.
Neither an API ACK nor REJECTED proves the final broker fill/position state by itself.
A complete close does not clear a daily-loss or DD5% stop; Q121 independent stop latches and separate human gates survive.
A fail-closed retry halt can leave an exposed position. Maintain feasible existing protective SL/management, urgent incident notification and human intervention, not unsafe duplicated trades.
unresolved_before_safety_implementation: Rakuten MT4 broker-specific order identity, order/deal history completeness, partial fills, rejection codes and delayed executions; demonstrate real or demo semantics before policy finalization.
Broker-side server SL check and actions when no safe local control is possible, including outages, closed market and position overhang.
Minimum retry interval, maximum retry count, deduplication/idempotency proof, external manual interventions and concurrent algorithm locks.
Exact evidence freshness/time-sync windows, history lag, pagination, identifier mapping, restart/DB corruption handling and account consistency.

Who may authorize a recovered close-out, what approvals and incident escalation are needed, and how authorization is authenticated/revoked; do not infer a blanket human approval requirement absent from original.
Atomicity boundaries: SQLite transactions cannot be atomic with the broker; identify the single-claim safety boundary and crash-proof replay procedure.
Integration of real account/position state with Q116 risk review, Q120 Q121 stop conditions and Q195-Q199 persistence; separate independent demo/fault-injection acceptance required.
